disputes.a: GTAScoop calls it Jason's first mission and says the trophy pops when you finish it.
disputes.b: GTABase is vaguer: one of the first missions of Chapter 1.
disputes.call: Unmissable either way — it lands inside the opening hour of Chapter 1.
disputes.q: Is Gone Fishing literally the first mission?

trophies.guide: The opening story mission hands you this one. Start the run clean, finish Gone Fishing, and bank a save — there is no mission replay later, so your 15 manual slots are your only insurance.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Start a fresh playthrough on a clean save and never enable cheats on it — cheats disable trophies and saving.
Play the opening of Chapter 1 as Jason until the mission Gone Fishing begins.
Follow the mission markers through Gone Fishing and finish the boat outing.
Complete the mission to its final checkpoint; the trophy pops as the mission wraps up.
Make a manual save right after the pop — you have 15 slots and no mission replay exists.
Keep rotating one extra save at the end of every chapter as insurance for the whole run.
Gone Fishing also teaches the boat handling the story assumes later — don't skip its tutorials.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: it unlocks after completing the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
disputes.b: GameMapa and the list sites simply say: finish Chapter 1.
disputes.call: Both are right in effect — the award is delayed to the first Chapter 2 mission. Play on.
disputes.q: Does Paradise Lost pop at the end of Chapter 1?

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission. The award is handed over late — it pops as Chapter 2 opens — so do not reload when Chapter 1 ends without a pop.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Work through every Chapter 1 story mission in order; none of them has gold-medal requirements.
After Down to Earth, watch Jason's house the next morning for Lucia's meditation offer — it belongs to another trophy and is lost after this chapter.
Start Kenton's and Cal's optional missions as they appear; both begin in this chapter.
Finish the chapter's final mission and roll into Chapter 2.
Start Chapter 2's opener, What's in the Bag? — the Chapter 1 trophy pops as it begins.
Bank a chapter-end manual save before continuing the story.
Sweep any newly unlocked optional missions before pushing on — several strands start at chapter boundaries.

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

disputes.a: PowerPyx treats it as a quest unlocked by Cal's text after Feng Shui.
disputes.b: HowToVideoGame files it with the activity trophies, since fishing is one of the 9 tracked activity types.
disputes.call: Both: a short questline whose finale is the fishing activity. Do the marked quest and the challenge is at its end.
disputes.q: Is Cal's contest a quest or a free-roam activity?

trophies.guide: Cal is introduced in Chapter 1 and his fishing contest is a short marked quest west of Key Lento. Do his warm-up fishing first, then out-catch him in the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Play Chapter 1 until the mission Feng Shui introduces Cal.
Wait for Cal's text message after Feng Shui; it marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Travel to the purple icon and start Cal's fishing quest.
Complete Cal's warm-up fishing quests to unlock his challenge.
Accept Cal's fishing challenge at the marked spot.
Out-catch Cal before the contest ends — land more fish than he does.
Cal's spot doubles as your Master of None fishing tick.
The winning margin doesn't matter — one fish ahead is enough.
Finish the challenge ahead of Cal and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: he becomes available again in Chapter 2–3, and every trophy quest giver is still around after the story.
disputes.b: EGamers relays a single-source warning that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.
disputes.call: Not missable per the two big guides, but start his sets early anyway — it costs nothing.
disputes.q: Is Kenton's strand missable when he disappears after Chapter 1?

disputes.a: KeenGamer's checklist table asks for 5 of 7 of Kenton's Treasure Sets.
disputes.b: The trophy itself needs his full questline — all 7 shipwrecks cleared.
disputes.call: Do all 7: the trophy is the stricter target and the checklist line completes itself along the way.
disputes.q: How much of Kenton does the 100% checklist want?

trophies.guide: Kenton Rees hires you in Chapter 1 to strip 7 shipwrecks. He vanishes for a while after the chapter — that is normal, he comes back — and his sets are tracked under Progress, so you always know how many wrecks are left.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Play Chapter 1 until Island Dreams puts you to work for Kenton.
Wait for Kenton's call; he is then marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Take his first treasure-diving set: follow the purple chest icons he marks on the map.
Dive each shipwreck and use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor.
Bring the recovered treasure back to Kenton's shop to close the set.
Return when he calls again and clear the next marked set of wrecks.
Keep clearing sets until all 7 shipwrecks are done — track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
If Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1, play on: he texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3, and calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up.
Each set Kenton gives you is a batch of wrecks — clear the whole batch before sailing back.
Track both counters: Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees for the strand, Collections for the sets.
His final set closes the strand — deliver it to trigger the finale.
Finish his final delivery and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: unconfirmed — it adds +1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot; their author did it and then earned the trophy.
disputes.b: GTABase: it isn't confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so don't skip it.
disputes.call: Do it. It costs two minutes in Chapter 1 and removes the only real risk in the whole list.
disputes.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required for the trophy?

disputes.a: EGamers' comparison table lists the trophy at 18 against the checklist's 15 and declines to pick one.
disputes.b: GameMapa: the trophy is all 18 spots; the checklist is the smaller ask.
disputes.call: Both numbers are real: 18 for this trophy, 15 for the checklist line.
disputes.q: How many meditations does the game actually ask for?

trophies.guide: The list's only real risk. One meditation — Lucia's balcony session at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — is gone for good when the chapter ends and may be required. Do that one the moment it appears, then sweep the 18 spots across 10 locations at your own pace.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen when she says she is going to meditate.
Follow Lucia onto the balcony and choose Accept so she teaches you the meditation.
Complete that balcony meditation even though it is not marked as a Meditation Spot — it raises the counter by 1 and cannot be repeated after Chapter 1.
Open Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and use it as your tracker from now on.
Meditate at every marked spot across the 10 locations as you unfog the map.
Bring both characters to each spot: meditating with Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2 toward the counter.
Leave the final spot until after Chapter 2's Coffee Break unlocks playing as both characters together.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed, but this trophy wants the full set — finish all 18.
Meditation spots sit at scenic spots across the 10 locations — combine the sweep with your Goodtime State unfogging route.
Do spots as they appear on your route instead of saving all 18 for the end.
If a spot won't register for one character, switch and meditate with the other — the pair bonus needs both.
Check the counter reads 18 and the trophy unlocks.

disputes.a: TrueAchievements and PowerPyx print it masked: T**s Ass Drug Money.
disputes.b: GamesFuze and Press Start print the word in full.
disputes.call: The masked spelling is what the platform lists themselves show, so the masked spelling is what we print.
disputes.q: Why is this trophy's name censored in most lists?

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the Chapter 1 award, this one is handed over as the next chapter opens, and its name is printed masked in the platform lists themselves.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Play every Chapter 2 story mission in order, starting with What's in the Bag?
Finish Breakfast Run when it appears — it carries its own trophy, Trust.
Complete Coffee Break; it unlocks free-roaming as Jason and Lucia together, which half of this list needs.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary before the finale.
Finish the last Chapter 2 mission and roll into Chapter 3.
Start Chapter 3's Welcome to Vice City — this award is handed over as the next chapter opens.
Before pushing deeper, start the Chapter 3 strands that just opened — their givers are marked on the map.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: automatic story-related trophy, cannot be missed.
disputes.b: Insider Gaming files it among the hidden trophies that carry story spoilers, which can read as missable.
disputes.call: Hidden only means masked until earned. It cannot be missed.
disputes.q: Can Trust be missed?

trophies.guide: A single Chapter 2 story mission. Play Breakfast Run to its end and the trophy is yours — it is automatic and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Progress Chapter 2 until the story mission Breakfast Run begins.
Play Breakfast Run through to its final checkpoint.
Finish the mission — the trophy is automatic and cannot be missed.
No optional objectives are required — completion alone pays the trophy.
Save manually right after; there is no way to replay the mission later.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase list the strands that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete — and name Billy among those that do NOT count.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's roadmap groups Billy with the character finales to finish in the cleanup step, which can read as if he counted.
disputes.call: He doesn't count toward the 8. His own trophy is the reason to finish him.
disputes.q: Does Billy's strand count toward Strangers & Freaks?

trophies.guide: Billy runs the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and has five jobs, all still available after the story. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — this trophy is the whole reason to finish it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break; Billy's questline is marked automatically right after it.
Ride to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County and start Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club).
Join Billy on Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab.
Join Billy on Mall Rats.
Steal the Impaler in The Impaler and bring it back.
Finish Hometown Heroes, his fifth and final job.
Billy's jobs all start at or around the Mudclub — there is no long travel between quests.
His strand stays open after the story; finish leftovers in cleanup.
The trophy pops when Hometown Heroes wraps up.

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly unlocks it.
disputes.b: EGamers: which animal is unconfirmed, full stop.
disputes.call: Nobody knows yet. Clear all 15 Target Decks — required for 100% regardless — and the trophy is guaranteed inside.
disputes.q: Which animal unlocks Fair Game?

disputes.a: PowerPyx: clean one-shot kills leave animals pristine and pay more, but are not mandatory for the questline.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's checklist counts decks completed, not kill quality.
disputes.call: Quality is money, not progress. Take the shot you can make.
disputes.q: Do Bret's animals need pristine one-shot kills?

trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason-only and runs through 15 Target Decks. Which single animal triggers this trophy is still unconfirmed anywhere — clear all 15 decks, which 100% completion demands anyway, and it cannot escape you.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, play as Jason and wait for Bret Vogel's text — Lucia cannot receive it.
Meet Bret in Lummox County and complete Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret).
Take the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 he gives you; retrieve it later from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Follow the purple hunting icons Bret marks and hunt the animals he requests.
Bring each requested animal back to Bret as Jason.
Use one clean shot where you can — pristine kills pay more, though they are not mandatory.
Work through his Target Decks; track them under Map > Activities > Target Deck.
Bret's requests escalate — later decks ask for rarer animals in remoter country.
Check Map > Activities > Target Deck before each trip so you hunt the deck that is actually open.
Hunt at the marked purple icons — animals outside Bret's requests don't advance the decks.
Complete all 15 Target Decks — the 100% checklist needs them all anyway, and the trophy's animal is somewhere in that set.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 8 purchasable plus 4 story-related garages, and only the 8 count.
disputes.b: EGamers: buy the 8 in the app, around $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages don't count.
disputes.call: Buy the 8 in the app. The 4 story garages are free and irrelevant here.
disputes.q: How many garages are there, and which count?

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages sold through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, and every purchase also feeds On the Spot, which needs parking space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Play Chapter 2 until Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) is done; garage buying unlocks there.
Open your phone and find the new Vice City Real Estate app that gets installed.
Raise money with robberies — the 8 purchasable garages cost about $160,000 in total.
Buy the first garage in the app; story garages don't count toward this trophy.
Keep buying as cash allows — Mitchel Auto Center is the cheapest way in at $4,000 for one parking spot.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages; the 4 story garages are not required.
Garage spots gate On the Spot — buy space ahead of registering vehicles.
The app lists each garage's price; buy cheapest-first to unlock spots quickly.
The trophy pops when the eighth purchase lands.

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: initially yes — Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with Standard Trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
disputes.b: GTABase compresses it to one line: at first he only takes cars without trackers.
disputes.call: Early on, steal cheap tracker-free cars. After Chapter 3 the restriction relaxes.
disputes.q: Do registered cars need to be tracker-free?

trophies.guide: Moses' Scooter Bros app turns stolen cars into summonable personal vehicles. Register 10 of them — cheap, tracker-free cars and bikes keep the fees down, and each one needs garage space you own.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses); it installs the Scooter Bros app on your phone.
Buy garage space first — every registered vehicle needs a parking spot (see Little Boxes).
Steal a cheap low-end car or bike with no tracker fitted.
Drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register, in his garage.
Pay the registration fee and confirm the vehicle in the app.
Repeat with tracker-free vehicles until you reach 10.
From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Bikes are the cheapest registrations — small fees, one garage spot each.
Register cars you already stole for missions instead of hunting fresh ones.
Register the tenth vehicle and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

disputes.a: The description says Kolt & Associates'; PowerPyx identifies Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn as one of the Kolts' gang operations.
disputes.b: GamesFuze prints only the description and leaves the location work to the player.
disputes.call: Same place: Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn, a Kolts operation, marked by a Chapter 2 optional mission.
disputes.q: Whose bowling alley is it, and where?

trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a Kolts gang operation holding three key valuables. Take all three — they do not need to happen in one visit — and lose the police afterwards.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

steps.t: Play Chapter 2 until the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling marks the alley in Port Gellhorn.
Enter Kingpin Bowling — it is a Kolt & Associates gang operation, so expect armed resistance.
Take the luxury watch from the office in the south-east of the alley (golden icon).
Take the unique shotgun, the Gutterball Moreland 850, from the table in the north-east corner.
Loot the safe in the office off the north-east hallway — code 0300, or blow it with sticky bombs.
Escape the police; the trophy unlocks only after you lose them, not when you grab the third item.
The three valuables show golden icons once you are inside — sweep the alley room by room.
Take the items in any order: office watch, corner shotgun, hallway safe.
Missed an item? The robbery icon respawns after a long wait — the three valuables do not need to be taken in one visit.

disputes.a: GTABase decodes it: max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia.
disputes.b: EGamers prints the same decode and credits GTABase for it.
disputes.call: Confirmed by the guides that tested it: two full Strength bars, held at the same time.
disputes.q: What does the cryptic description actually want?

trophies.guide: The riddle description means Strength: max it out for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train together — while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so every session counts twice.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: Wait until Chapter 2's Coffee Break unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia.
Check both Strength levels: Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon).
Call your partner — hold Right and press Triangle — so you always travel to the gym together.
Filter the map for fitness clubs under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) and pick one.
Buy a membership and work out with one character; the other trains automatically alongside, so progress doubles.
Keep training together until Jason's Strength maxes out.
Keep going until Lucia's Strength is also maxed at the same time.
Check both bars after every session so the laggard character leads the next one.
Alternate who leads each session; the follower trains free, so never train solo.
After the story you can also work out at home — either way, both bars full at once pops the trophy.

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

disputes.a: PowerPyx's route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police can't follow on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.
disputes.b: GameMapa points at the same tunnel, and notes the trophy often unlocks by itself during bank vault robberies.
disputes.call: Tunnel if you're doing it on purpose; the Chapter 4 vaults if you're not.
disputes.q: What is the easiest way to escape the 4 stars?

trophies.guide: Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break the search completely — the trophy lands when you leave the red heat zone, not when the flashing circle ends. Bank vault robberies in Chapter 4 hand you this situation for free.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break so Jason and Lucia can free-roam together.
Call your partner: hold Right and press Triangle.
Cause carnage together until your Wanted Level reaches 4 stars.
Grab a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic out of the search area.
If a helicopter is on you, shoot at it until it breaks off.
Or dive into the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.
Keep going until you leave the red heat zone entirely; the trophy unlocks then, not when the flashing search circle ends.
Do it in Chapter 2 if you want it early; the vault shortcut needs Chapter 4's optional mission first.
Stay together — if your partner is left behind, re-call them before starting the rampage.
Short on patience? Rob a large bank vault in Chapter 4 instead — vaults force a 4-star escape with your partner by design.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: it unlocks after finishing Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4.
disputes.b: GameMapa: simply complete Chapter 3.
disputes.call: Delayed like the earlier chapters — play into Chapter 4 and it lands.
disputes.q: When does the Chapter 3 trophy actually pop?

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The award again lands late, after two early Chapter 4 missions, and this chapter quietly unlocks half the side content: Tyrone, Randy, the Snap Gun and the Payday Loans robberies.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Play every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
Complete The Cartel Heist when it appears — it carries its own trophy, Break the Bank.
Finish Here, Kitty Kitty and Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — they unlock Tyrone's strand and the Payday Loans robberies.
Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to receive the Snap Gun, which Sneakthief needs.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary.
Finish the chapter's closing missions, then play Chapter 4's Ocean Beach and Another Life — the Chapter 3 award pops after them.
Take Chapter 4's optional vault mission when it appears — it unlocks the robbery endgame.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: automatic story-related trophy.
disputes.b: OutputLag lists it among the hidden trophies without saying whether it can be missed.
disputes.call: Hidden, not missable — it is bolted to a mandatory mission.
disputes.q: Is Break the Bank missable?

trophies.guide: One mandatory Chapter 3 set-piece. Play The Cartel Heist to the end and the trophy is automatic.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Progress Chapter 3 until the story mission The Cartel Heist begins.
Play The Cartel Heist through to its final checkpoint.
No optional objectives or collectibles gate this trophy — completion alone pays it.
Finish the heist — the trophy is automatic on completion.
Bank a manual save afterwards; story missions cannot be replayed.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: no — the counting strands are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete only.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's roadmap still finishes Andy in the same cleanup step as the counting strands.
disputes.call: Finish him for this trophy, not for the 8.
disputes.q: Does Andy's strand count toward Strangers & Freaks?

trophies.guide: Andy Cellerica's supplement hustle in Belville is Lucia-only and runs seven short quests in Chapter 3. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — this trophy is the payoff.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and head to Belville; Andy's questline is exclusive to her.
Start Climbing the Cellerichain (Part 1) when Andy texts.
Continue with Climbing the Cellerichain (Part 2).
Continue with Climbing the Cellerichain (Part 3).
Complete Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Complete Peach!.
Complete Read the Label.
Andy's quests arrive by text in sequence — if one stalls, finish Lucia's other business and the next text lands.
The finale, Puff Puff Pass, only appears after Read the Label is done.
Finish Puff Puff Pass, Andy's final quest — the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase: Randy is not among the four counting strangers.
disputes.b: GTA Zone's stranger roundup covers Randy among the finale trophies without the counting caveat.
disputes.call: Not a counting strand. The 16 cars are for this trophy and the checklist.
disputes.q: Does Randy's strand count toward Strangers & Freaks?

trophies.guide: Randy Klay wants 16 specific cars stolen to order. The Key Cloner from Chapter 3 makes it possible, his Wish List is tracked on the map, and hotel driveways on Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are where the rare ones surface.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — it unlocks the Key Cloner Randy's strand needs.
Go to the green RK icon west of Vice City and meet Randy.
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List and read the 16 cars he wants.
Hunt the listed cars where they spawn — Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotel driveways are rich hunting grounds.
Deliver the first car: the Granforma Zorrusso is delivered automatically.
Deliver the Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus and Buckingham Windsor Drop.
Deliver the Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta and Ascot Paragon.
Deliver the Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee and Grotti Itali RSX.
Deliver the Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire and Piccia Furia.
Deliver the Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D.
Steal to order: only Wish List models count — similar models don't advance the list.
Check the Wish List after every delivery — the next target is always shown.
The strand stays open after the story, so leftover cars can be finished in cleanup.
Deliver the sixteenth and final car — the trophy pops when Randy's list is complete.

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

disputes.a: PowerPyx names Tyrone among the strands that do NOT count.
disputes.b: GTAScoop's stranger coverage lists Tyrone's finale trophy without the distinction.
disputes.call: He doesn't count. Do him for the trophy and the cleanup, not the 8.
disputes.q: Does Tyrone count toward Strangers & Freaks?

trophies.guide: Tyrone's Synthetic Lab takedowns are Jason-only and unlock in Chapter 3. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks; the finale, Shut Down the Labs, carries this trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Play as Jason and finish Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty; Tyrone's strand is Jason-only.
Follow the purple Synthetic Lab markers Tyrone sends you to.
Complete Take Out Kitty Litter, his opening job.
Keep clearing his Synthetic Lab quests as they appear.
Finish his final quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs).
Each lab you shut down is one of his Synthetic Lab quests — clear them as the purple markers appear.
His strand stays open after the story.
The trophy pops when the last lab is shut down.

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

disputes.a: PowerPyx names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds as the spot, entered by the Snap Gun back door.
disputes.b: OutputLag only repeats the description: rob a jewelry store without being detected.
disputes.call: Richardson is the proven one — the Snap Gun back door is built for it.
disputes.q: Which store should you rob?

trophies.guide: The Snap Gun from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs opens a jewelry store's back door silently. Go in the back of Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, kill the cameras and the alarm, and walk out unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to receive the Snap Gun.
Travel to Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
Walk to the shop's back door — do NOT kick it open; kicking triggers the alarm.
Use the Snap Gun on the back door to enter silently.
Find the safe code on the note in the backroom.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm inside.
Loot the store and leave without ever being detected.
Case the shop first: the back door, the backroom note and the alarm are all at the rear of the store.
Leave through the back door the same way you came in.
The trophy pops once the undetected robbery is complete.

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: Yasmani pays the most, but the total counts wherever you sell.
disputes.b: EGamers words it as laundering through your contacts, plural.
disputes.call: Any fence counts. Yasmani is just the best rate.
disputes.q: Must Marked Bills go to one specific fence?

trophies.guide: Robberies pay partly in Marked Bills; fencing them is a cumulative $250,000 counter. Yasmani pays the best rate, and the Payday Loans circuit unlocked in Chapter 3 keeps the bills flowing.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer and Payday Loans robberies.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores; some of the cash comes out as Marked Bills.
Take Marked Bills to a fence — Yasmani pays the most for them.
Sell every stack of Marked Bills you pick up; the counter is cumulative.
Keep robbing Payday Loans and banks between story missions to keep the bills coming.
Marked Bills come from bank and Payday Loans hauls — prioritise those two robbery types.
Sell bills in batches after each robbery run so none sit unsold.
Launder $250,000 in total and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives the full method: the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, out through the window — a GTA III tribute.
disputes.b: GameMapa, EGamers, GTABase and KeenGamer all still list this trophy as unconfirmed.
disputes.call: One detailed method against four shrugs. Try the Banshee run — it is cheap to test.
disputes.q: Is the showroom method confirmed?

trophies.guide: A GTA III tribute hiding in a showroom window. One guide has a full method — steal the specific blue Banshee in south Vice City with the Key Cloner and drive it straight out through the glass — while most lists still call it unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner — the target car cannot be taken without it.
Travel to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City.
Find the specific blue Banshee inside the showroom.
Use the Key Cloner approach to steal the blue Banshee.
Drive the Banshee straight out through the showroom's front window.
Keep driving away from the showroom — the trophy pops with a delay as you leave.
Pair the trip with Chapter 3 errands in south Vice City to save the drive.

disputes.a: PowerPyx decodes it: rob the Prologue's Payday Loans store a second time, solo as Lucia, and escape on foot.
disputes.b: GameMapa and EGamers still mark the trophy unconfirmed.
disputes.call: The decode fits the description exactly. Rob it again, on foot.
disputes.q: Why 'second time's the charm'?

trophies.guide: The description is the hint: the Prologue's robbery, done a second time. Go back to the Little Cuba Payday Loans store alone as Lucia, empty its three cash drawers, and escape on foot — a vehicle escape does not count.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
Switch to Lucia and travel alone to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba — the same store robbed in the Prologue.
Aim your gun at the teller to start the robbery.
Kill the security guard when he intervenes.
Break into the back and loot all 3 cash drawers.
Escape on foot — fleeing in a vehicle does not count.
Lose the police on foot; the trophy pops with a delay after the escape.
Solo means solo — dismiss your partner before you enter Little Cuba.

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: leaving a store before police arrive, or dropping out of the heat at the wrong moment, can void a link — a fourth shop fixes it.
disputes.b: GameMapa states the rule plainly: 3 shops, partner present, Wanted Level never lost.
disputes.call: Chain carefully and keep a fourth store in mind as the repair.
disputes.q: Why does the chain sometimes fail?

trophies.guide: Three shops, one unbroken Wanted Level, partner beside you. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close enough to chain after Chapter 3, and the pop can lag half a minute behind the third robbery.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2's Coffee Break so your partner can join you.
Gear up first: buy an armored vest, sticky bombs, and Zombix or Adrenaline snacks.
Call your partner — hold Right and press Triangle.
Wait until Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs is done, then target the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — they sit close together.
Rob the first store and let the police arrive before you leave; leaving too early can break the chain.
Keep your Wanted Level flashing — in the search phase, not the heat phase — while you drive to the second store.
Rob the second store the same way, looting the back-room safe if it has one.
Drive to the third store without ever fully losing the Wanted Level.
Rob the third store; the trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop afterwards.
Stick to one district so drive time never lets the Wanted Level lapse between stores.
Keep the search active between stores — if the stars stop flashing entirely, the chain is broken and you start over.
If it doesn't pop, rob a fourth shop — sometimes one robbery in the chain doesn't register.

disputes.a: PowerPyx's roadmap describes five story chapters, with the finale after Chapter 4's Starting From Zero and Chapter 5 content (Operation Savage Glory) still to come.
disputes.b: EGamers, relaying Beebom and CULTR, words the finale as the last mission of Chapter 5.
disputes.call: Five chapters either way. This award pops at Chapter 4's end; the finale trophy is separate.
disputes.q: How many chapters are there, really?

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, whose finale is Starting From Zero. The chapter also carries three mission trophies of its own and unlocks the bank vault circuit.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Play every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
Complete Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown as they appear — each carries its own trophy.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears; it unlocks the bank vault robberies.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary.
Finish Starting From Zero, the Chapter 4 finale.
The Chapter 4 award pops as the finale wraps up.
With the vault circuit open, Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play are now available in free roam.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: automatic story-related trophy.
disputes.b: Insider Gaming lists it among the hidden story trophies without a missable note.
disputes.call: Automatic. Play the mission, get the trophy.
disputes.q: Is Family Matters missable?

trophies.guide: A mandatory Chapter 4 mission. Play Child's Play to the end; the trophy is automatic.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Progress Chapter 4 until the story mission Child's Play begins.
Play Child's Play through to its final checkpoint.
No optional objectives or collectibles gate this trophy — completion alone pays it.
Finish the mission — the trophy is automatic on completion.
Bank a manual save afterwards; story missions cannot be replayed.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: automatic story-related trophy.
disputes.b: OutputLag prints the description only, with no method.
disputes.call: Automatic on a mandatory mission — nothing to prepare.
disputes.q: Is DWNFALL missable?

trophies.guide: A mandatory Chapter 4 mission. Play Headliners to the end; the trophy is automatic.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Progress Chapter 4 until the story mission Headliners begins.
Play Headliners through to its final checkpoint.
No optional objectives or collectibles gate this trophy — completion alone pays it.
Finish the mission — the trophy is automatic on completion.
Bank a manual save afterwards; story missions cannot be replayed.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: automatic story-related trophy.
disputes.b: games.gg lists it among the hidden Chapter 4 trophies with no extra conditions.
disputes.call: Automatic. The airport set-piece pays it out at the end.
disputes.q: Is Hi-Jacked missable?

trophies.guide: A mandatory Chapter 4 mission at the airport. Play VCIA Takedown to the end; the trophy is automatic — and the airport itself matters again for a secret trophy later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Progress Chapter 4 until the story mission VCIA Takedown begins.
Play VCIA Takedown through to its final checkpoint.
No optional objectives or collectibles gate this trophy — completion alone pays it.
Finish the mission — the trophy is automatic on completion.
Bank a manual save afterwards; story missions cannot be replayed.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: vault robberies unlock through Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
disputes.b: Push Square's roadmap reaches the same circuit later, in its endgame robbery step.
disputes.call: The optional mission is the gate. Take it in Chapter 4 and the vaults open.
disputes.q: When do bank vault robberies unlock?

trophies.guide: The heavy end of robbery: tail the security van, hit the vault inside its open window, and hand the haul to your partner — it is too heavy to carry alone. Five escapes from the eight Large Bank Jobs does it, and every vault escape is a forced 4-star run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: In Chapter 4, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it unlocks robbing bank vaults in free roam.
Buy tips from Yasmani, who sells security van locations for $10,000 after his two Payday Loans quests.
Call your partner before every job — hold Right and press Triangle; the haul is too heavy for one character.
Tail the security van from a tip until it reaches its bank.
Wait for the vault to open, then move in during the open window.
Grab the money inside the vault — a full haul can reach $205,000.
Hand bags to your partner with hold Right when your carry is full.
Expect an instant 4-star Wanted Level the moment the vault is hit.
Escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles once you break line of sight.
Lose the heat completely to bank the escape — a vault only counts once you are clear.
Repeat until 5 of the 8 Large Bank Jobs are escaped cleanly.
There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; you need any 5 of them.
Buy van tips in batches so you can chain vaults in one session.
Keep a Pay 'n' Spray on your escape route as a heat reset if the bike run goes wrong.
The fifth clean escape pops the trophy.

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: the Chapter 4 optional mission counts by itself — its vault robbery is treated as an armored truck robbery.
disputes.b: OutputLag and the list sites give no method at all, just the description.
disputes.call: If the mission didn't pop it, the open-world method below is five minutes of work.
disputes.q: Does the story's vault job count as an armored truck?

trophies.guide: An armored truck, a blocked road and sticky bombs on the back doors. Chapter 4's vault mission may hand it to you automatically; if not, the open-world method is quick.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: First try the free route: play Chapter 4's optional That's Where The Money Is… — its vault robbery counts as an armored truck robbery.
If the trophy hasn't popped, buy sticky bombs — they are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop.
Find an armored truck in traffic and block its path with your vehicle.
Plant sticky bombs on the truck's back doors.
Detonate the bombs to blow the doors open.
Grab the cash from inside the truck.
Escape the heat, or drive into a Pay 'n' Spray to clear it.
Armored trucks cruise in traffic across the state — circle commercial districts if none appears.
Do this before the vault circuit in your route and the same escape skills carry over.
Once you are clear with the money, the trophy pops.

disputes.a: EGamers, via Beebom and CULTR: the final story mission belongs to Chapter 5.
disputes.b: PowerPyx's chapter walkthrough ties the endgame to Chapter 4's finale, Starting From Zero, before Chapter 5 content.
disputes.call: Either way it is the last stretch of the story. Keep a save before the endgame begins.
disputes.q: Which chapter does the endgame belong to?

trophies.guide: A late-story mission in the endgame stretch. Play Operation Savage Glory to the end; the trophy is automatic, and you are nearly at the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Progress the late story until Operation Savage Glory begins.
Play Operation Savage Glory through to its final checkpoint.
No optional objectives or collectibles gate this trophy — completion alone pays it.
Finish the mission — the trophy is automatic on completion.
Bank a manual save afterwards; the finale is close and missions cannot be replayed.

disputes.a: PowerPyx's roadmap counts five chapters and places the finale after Chapter 4's closing mission in its step order.
disputes.b: EGamers words it as the last mission of Chapter 5.
disputes.call: Chapter numbering aside, there is one final mission and this is its trophy. Finish the story.
disputes.q: Is the finale Chapter 4's or Chapter 5's last mission?

trophies.guide: The story's last mission and the bigger of the two Golds. Finish it and the narrative is done — everything left afterwards is the 100% grind, which the game tracks for you under Progress.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish every story mission up to the finale, including Operation Savage Glory.
Make a manual save before starting the final mission — there is no replay if anything goes wrong.
Start the final mission with full health, armor and snacks for both characters.
Play the final mission through its last checkpoint.
Finish the final mission and watch the story close out.
The Gold pops as the finale completes.
After the credits, open Touchpad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — your grind checklist is live now.
Free roam stays fully open after the finale — nothing in the grind is locked behind the credits.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase both budget about 200 hours for the platinum.
disputes.b: Push Square warns the platinum can run up to 300 hours.
disputes.call: Plan for 200; Push Square's 300 is the completionist worst case.
disputes.q: How long does 100% take?

disputes.a: KeenGamer: the checklist is about 60% of total tracked completion — the rest is optional depth.
disputes.b: GameMapa presents the checklist itself as the 100% target.
disputes.call: The trophy follows the checklist. The other 40% is for your own satisfaction.
disputes.q: Is the in-game checklist the whole game?

trophies.guide: The big Gold and the spine of the whole run. The game's own checklist — live under Progress after the story — is the target: roughly 200 hours of missions, robberies, races, stunts and collections, almost all of it tracked in-game with generous slack on most lines.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story first — the 100% checklist only appears afterwards.
Open Touchpad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and treat it as your master tracker.
Know that progress made before finishing the story already counts toward the checklist.
Complete all story and optional missions the checklist lists.
Clear all robberies: 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs and 7 payday jobs.
Make all 33 underwater discoveries.
Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges.
Win all 42 drone races.
Complete Bret's 15 Target Decks.
Complete 100 optional missions — purple map icons, plus black icons with pink letters; 200–300+ exist, so you have slack.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles for the checklist (Whip It Good only needs 100 discovered).
Study 100 of 255 animals with the binoculars.
Meditate at 15 of 18 spots for the checklist (the trophy itself wants all 18).
Complete 70 of 80 challenges.
Complete 300 stunts.
Scan 100 WAiNK spots.
Complete 15 of 18 collectible card sets.
Complete 5 of 7 of Kenton's Treasure Sets.
Collect 30 of 34 magazines.
Destroy 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos.
Complete both playlists (2 of 2).
Unlock 70 of 79 styles.
Own 50 of 66 weapons.
Win 30 of 40 races.
Earn gold in 10 of 13 race challenges.
Beat 5 of 7 pool opponents.
Complete 2 of 3 mini golf courses.
Score 90 of 100 basketball hoops.
Complete all 4 video games.
Fence $100,000 worth of narcotics.
Fence $100,000 worth of jewelry.
Fence $250,000 worth of marked bills — Dime on the Dollar is this exact line.
Fence $200,000 worth of vehicles.
Complete 34 of 35 Smash 'N' Grabs.
Complete 50 of 91 Stick Ups.
Use the slack: most lines ask for less than the full pool, so take the easy entries first and skip the hardest outliers.
Finish the no-slack lines deliberately: underwater discoveries want 33 of 33 and Target Decks 15 of 15.
Sweep collectibles district by district — magazines, flamingos and cards ride along with your stunt routes.
Re-open the checklist after each sweep and confirm every line reads complete.
When the counter reaches 100%, the Gold pops.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: under-bridge flights are the quickest stunts to complete.
disputes.b: Push Square's roadmap leaves stunts to general cleanup without ranking the types.
disputes.call: Bridges first — 202 of them is most of the trophy by itself.
disputes.q: Which stunt type is fastest?

trophies.guide: 397 stunts exist and you need 250: jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, all marked on the map and tracked by region. Bridges are the fast bulk; the checklist later asks for 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Open Progress > Activities > Stunts to see your count; press R3 there to filter by region.
Or open Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see every stunt location.
Know the pool: 397 stunts total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Start with under-bridge flights — at 202 of them they are the fastest bulk.
Fly a plane under each marked bridge; the stunt registers as you pass beneath it.
Move to stunt jumps: hit each marked ramp and land cleanly on the far side.
Use a fast motorcycle for jumps that need a short run-up.
Do knife flights next: tilt the plane 90 degrees and hold the knife position between the marked buildings.
Finish with base jumps: climb each marked structure and jump, opening the parachute before landing.
Work region by region using the R3 filter so nothing is left scattered.
Re-check the Activities > Stunts counter after every region.
Chain nearby stunts into one route to cut travel time between attempts.
Respawn is instant after a failed stunt — retry on the spot instead of moving on.
If a jump keeps failing, change vehicle class: bikes for short run-ups, cars for stability.
Mark finished regions off as you go so the last stunts are easy to locate.
Complete the 250th stunt and the trophy pops; the push to 300 serves the 100% checklist.

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: yes — ranges are one of the ways to raise Focus levels, which Gunslinger needs.
disputes.b: Push Square treats ranges mainly as this trophy and a checklist line (all 42 golds).
disputes.call: Both — gold them all and your Focus climbs with them.
disputes.q: Do ranges matter beyond this trophy?

trophies.guide: 42 challenges across 12 ranges, every one gold. Ranges double as Focus training, so this Silver quietly feeds Gunslinger too.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit any of the 12 shooting ranges — they sit inside Ammu-Nation stores and at other spots on the map.
Start a challenge and read its gold requirement before shooting.
Earn gold by hitting the required score before the timer ends.
Retry freely — challenges can be repeated until the gold lands.
Practise on the range's free targets between attempts to learn each layout.
Gold every challenge at your first range before touring the others.
Work through all 42 challenges across the 12 ranges.
Use the ranges early and often: they also raise your Focus levels.
Keep your Focus bar filled with food and drinks before the hardest challenges.
If a challenge stalls you, swap weapon class and come back with better guns later.
Track your golds under Progress — every challenge needs gold, not just completion.
Each range hosts several challenges — finish a whole range before moving on.
Golds are permanent once earned; only the missing golds need work.
Earn the 42nd gold medal and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 42 races across 14 locations — win one per location for the trophy, all 42 for the checklist.
disputes.b: HowToVideoGame's entry gives only the description, which reads like 14 races total.
disputes.call: 14 locations, 42 races. The trophy needs 14 wins; the checklist needs 42.
disputes.q: How many drone races are there?

trophies.guide: One win at each of the 14 Top Fun locations. The checklist later wants all 42 races won, so learning the courses now pays twice.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Find a Top Fun drone race start point — there are 14 locations.
Start the race and fly the course through every checkpoint.
Win the race at that location — one win per location is what this trophy counts.
Repeat at all 14 locations.
Sweep locations region by region alongside your stunt route as you unfog the map.
Take a sighting run first if a win keeps slipping away — the checkpoints are fixed.
Restart a lost race immediately at the same start point.
Memorise the tight turns on each course; the racing line never changes.
For the 100% checklist, keep going: all 42 drone races must be won there.
Win one race per location first; save the remaining races for the checklist phase.
Drone races share districts with stunt spots — route them together.
Win at the fourteenth location and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: no — 20 different races; repeats add nothing.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's checklist asks for 30 of 40 races won, a different and bigger target.
disputes.call: 20 unique wins for the trophy, 30 for the checklist line.
disputes.q: Do repeat wins count?

trophies.guide: Twenty different races, won once each — repeats are worthless here. There are 40 races in the game, and the checklist raises the bar to 30.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Open the map and pick any race you have not won yet — repeats do not count.
Win the race; only first place counts.
Move to a different race each time — there are 40 races and you need 20 different wins.
Bring a tuned car or bike suited to each race class.
Restart freely after a loss; only wins register.
Track your distinct wins as you go — the game counts unique races, not total victories.
Street races from Yago's strand count too — his line is part of the counting Strangers.
Win races while unfogging the map to stack progress with The Goodtime State.
For the checklist, push on to 30 races won.
Different race types all count — street races and Yago's strand races included.
Pick the shortest races to bank unique wins quickly.
Win your 20th different race and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: EGamers' table prints 80 total against the trophy's 50 and the checklist's 70 without separating them.
disputes.b: GameMapa separates them cleanly: 50 for the trophy, 70 for the checklist, 80 exist.
disputes.call: Three numbers, three jobs: 50 / 70 / 80.
disputes.q: How many challenges does the game actually want?

trophies.guide: The challenge list under Progress is the game's errand board: 80 challenges exist, this trophy takes 50, and the checklist takes 70. Most complete themselves while you work on everything else.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Challenges to see the challenge list.
Read a challenge's requirement and its Completed tick state.
Pick challenges that overlap with what you are already doing — races, stunts, robberies.
Many challenges complete themselves during the 9 Master of None activities.
Complete challenges one by one; each finished one ticks over immediately.
There are 80 challenges in total; this trophy needs 50.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80 — keep going past the trophy on the platinum route.
Check the Progress > Challenges counter after each play session.
Park any challenge that needs an unfogged location and sweep it during your Goodtime State route.
Challenges tick automatically when their condition is met — there is no hand-in.
Prioritise challenges that overlap your current grind to finish two counters at once.
Complete your 50th challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.

disputes.a: PowerPyx lists them: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, race, stunt.
disputes.b: HowToVideoGame files several of these under their own trophies instead of one combined list.
disputes.call: The Progress > Activities screen is the arbiter — 9 types, one attempt each.
disputes.q: What exactly are the 9 activity types?

trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one attempt each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, race, stunt. Most are already covered by other trophies — this one is a checklist of leftovers.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the 9 activity types.
Filter the map to Activities (blue dumbbell icons) to find start points.
Go fishing once — Cal's Chapter 1 quest already covers this.
Go hunting once — Bret's Target Decks cover this.
Play golf once at any course.
Shoot once at any shooting range.
Play pool once against any opponent.
Play basketball once at any hoop.
Complete one video game — the TV games at home count.
Enter and finish one race of any kind.
Complete one stunt of any type.
Check Progress > Activities again — all 9 types should now show activity.
Most types are already ticked by other trophies — check the screen before hunting any activity.
The map's Activities filter shows the nearest start point for any missing type.
Try whichever type is still blank; the trophy pops when the ninth type registers.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 557 vehicles in total, discovered by driving them; the checklist separately scans 200 of 277.
disputes.b: Push Square's entry gives no totals, only the 100 target.
disputes.call: 557 exist, 100 for the trophy, 200 scanned for the checklist.
disputes.q: How many vehicles are in the game?

trophies.guide: Get in and drive 100 different vehicles out of the 557 in the game. Varied districts spawn varied traffic, and Randy's deliveries plus story vehicles stack discoveries for free.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles to see which of the 557 vehicles you have discovered.
A vehicle is discovered the first time you get in and drive it.
Steal parked cars in varied neighborhoods — different districts spawn different models.
Work busy roads: traffic variety is highest there.
Check marinas and airfields for boats and aircraft to widen the pool.
Enter every new model you see, even briefly — entering is enough.
Drive scripted vehicles in story missions instead of skipping those segments.
Randy's 16 Wish List deliveries all count as discoveries on the way.
Sweep airports and showrooms when nearby — they are dense with rare models.
Re-check the Vehicles screen after each district sweep.
For the checklist the target is higher: scan 200 of 277 scannable vehicles.
Airport loops are discovery-dense: service vehicles, rentals and parked exotics in one circuit.
Keep a mental shortlist of models you haven't driven and grab them on sight.
Discover your 100th vehicle and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: PowerPyx breaks it down: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags — 100+ spots in total.
disputes.b: Push Square gives only the 100 target.
disputes.call: Scan everything the scanner flags; you pass 100 before the categories run out.
disputes.q: How many WAiNK spots are there?

trophies.guide: The WAiNK scanner turns sightseeing into a counter: 100 points of interest scanned out of 100+ in the world, split across Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher Tags. It unlocks in Chapter 1 and pairs naturally with unfogging the map.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Hold Up on the D-pad, then press R1 to open the WAiNK scanner — it unlocks automatically in Chapter 1.
Aim the scanner at a marked point of interest until the scan completes.
A scan only counts at a genuine point of interest — random objects won't register.
Work the Landmarks first — there are 31 of them.
Scan the 35 Curiosities next.
Scan the 23 Sculptures.
Scan No Flusher Tags whenever you spot one — over 100 scan spots exist in total.
Scan opportunistically during story travel instead of making dedicated trips early.
Combine scanning with unfogging the map; every new district holds fresh spots.
Leave a district only when its spots are exhausted — backtracking costs more than sweeping.
Check your scan count as you go — the trophy needs 100 locations.
No Flusher Tags are the easiest bulk after the named categories — they are scattered through every district.
If a scan won't complete, reposition until the spot sits centred in the scanner view.
Scan your 100th location and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: KeenGamer's checklist: 15 of 18 sets for 100%; the trophy needs 3 complete sets.
disputes.b: Push Square's entry states the 3-set target without totals.
disputes.call: 18 sets exist. Any 3 complete sets earn the trophy.
disputes.q: How many card sets are there?

trophies.guide: Collectible cards come in themed sets scattered across the state; a set only pays out when every card in it is found. Any 3 complete sets earn the Silver — the checklist later demands 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Find collectible cards in the world — they are physical pickups at marked spots.
Each card belongs to a themed set; completing a set means collecting every card in it.
Track set progress as you collect — partial sets pay nothing until complete.
Pick a small set first and sweep all of its locations in one route.
Collect cards on your stunt and scan routes instead of making dedicated trips.
Prioritise sets whose cards cluster in districts you have already unfogged.
Complete your first full set.
Complete a second full set the same way.
If one card sits in a spot you can't reach yet, finish other sets first and return later.
Re-check your sets after each district sweep so no nearly-done set is forgotten.
For the checklist, keep going: 15 of 18 sets are required there.
Start card hunting in districts you have already unfogged to keep routes short.
A set completes the moment its last card is picked up — there is no hand-in.
Complete a third full set — the trophy pops.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase both say: by plane — it is the fastest way to explore the whole map.
disputes.b: Insider Gaming's entry gives no method at all.
disputes.call: Plane first, boat and car for the leftovers.
disputes.q: What is the fastest way to unfog everything?

trophies.guide: Unfog the entire state. A plane pass does most of it; boats and cars mop up the coastline and inland pockets, and the sweep stacks with vehicle discoveries and WAiNK scans.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Open the map and note the fogged regions — every one must be visited.
Story missions unfog their own areas automatically — check the map after each chapter.
Take a plane: flying over a region unfogs it fastest.
Sweep the map in a grid, region by region, rather than chasing single spots.
Cover the islands and coastline by boat where the plane pass leaves gaps.
Drive the remaining inland pockets on your stunt and collectible routes.
Combine the sweep with Whip It Good and WAiNKer — all three progress together.
Re-open the map after each sweep and mark what is still fogged.
Visit the last fogged pocket.
The state includes the islands — a map that looks full from the air can still hide coastal fog.
Finish the sweep before the final grind so every later route starts from a full map.
When the whole state is explored, the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: 39 operations across 9 gangs; the trophy needs one per gang.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's checklist wants all 39 operations robbed.
disputes.call: One per gang for the trophy (9); all 39 for the checklist.
disputes.q: How many gang operations are there?

trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 Illegal Operations across Leonida. Rob one operation per gang for the trophy — all 39 only matter to the checklist — and track your coverage under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Open Progress > Gangs to see the 9 gangs and their operations.
Find a gang's Illegal Operation — they are marked with yellow icons on the map.
Rob the operation: clear the gang members and take the valuables.
Escape the area to bank the robbery.
Kingpin Bowling is a Kolts operation — Let's Go Bowling already put one gang on your board.
Rob at least one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Vary your targets — repeating one gang's operations doesn't advance the other gangs.
Bring your partner and armor — operations are defended like small fortresses.
Operations respawn over time, so a botched robbery is retryable later.
Track coverage under Progress > Gangs after each robbery.
For the checklist, all 39 operations must be robbed, not just one per gang.
Yellow icons mark operations even before you visit the district — plan routes around them.
Tick gangs off in Progress > Gangs as you go so the last gang is obvious.
Rob the ninth gang's operation and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: The description says across all shops, and PowerPyx's shop census (24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores and more) is written for a statewide spend.
disputes.b: EGamers repeats the description without a breakdown.
disputes.call: Cumulative, everywhere. Spend normally and it lands mid-run.
disputes.q: Must the $100,000 be spent in one shop?

trophies.guide: A cumulative $100,000 spent anywhere: guns, car mods, clothes, tattoos, electronics. Leonida has hundreds of shops, and spending you'd do anyway — weapons and full car builds — moves the counter fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Open any shop and start spending — the counter is cumulative across all shops.
Buy weapons and ammo at Ammu-Nation — there are 24 of them.
Mod your cars at the 14 Mod Shops; upgrades are the fastest sink.
Use Pay 'n' Sprays (19 of them) whenever you need a respray or a heat reset.
Buy outfits at the 67 Clothing Stores.
Buy shoes at the 17 Footwear Stores.
Visit the 18 Hair & Beauty salons for cuts and styling.
Get tattoos at the 11 Tattoo Studios.
Buy gear at the 15 Electronics Stores.
Expensive single purchases — top-end weapons and full car builds — move the counter fastest.
Prioritise spending you'd do anyway before vanity items.
Weapon and vehicle spending you'd do anyway carries most of the total — don't buy junk just for the counter.
Shops in every district count — there is no need to return to one store.
Spend your $100,000th dollar and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: PowerPyx counts the three home TV games plus the Bang For Your Buck cabinets — 4 video games in total.
disputes.b: HowToVideoGame's wording leans on arcade cabinets only.
disputes.call: The TV games count and are easier to reach. The checklist wants all 4.
disputes.q: What counts as an arcade game here?

trophies.guide: Finish every level of one video game. The three TV games at home are playable from Chapter 1 and are the safest pick; Bang For Your Buck cabinets cover the fourth game the checklist wants.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Find a playable game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind run on the TV at home, available from Chapter 1.
Or find Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets out in the world.
The home TV games are the safest pick — no travel, no wanted level, instant retries.
Start the game and play it from the beginning.
'Complete' means finishing all of the game's levels once.
Retry levels as needed — you only need one full completion.
Finish every level of your chosen game without quitting out.
Complete the final level — the trophy pops.
Master of None also needs one video game tried, so this completion covers that line too.
Bang For Your Buck cabinets also sit in arcades and bars out in the world.
Finish one game completely before starting another; the trophy needs a full completion, not attempts.
For the checklist, all 4 video games must be completed.

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: gang-operation criminals count; soldiers, police and civilians do not trigger it.
disputes.b: OutputLag prints the description with no target restrictions mentioned.
disputes.call: Trust the restriction — do it at a gang operation or it will never pop.
disputes.q: Who counts as an enemy for this?

trophies.guide: Five takedowns inside one Combat Focus window. The catch is the target list: only gang-operation criminals count. Build your Focus level first, buff the bar, then trigger slow motion in the middle of a crowded operation.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Learn the input: while aiming, press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus (slow motion).
Watch the purple Focus bar at the top-left — Focus drains while active.
Raise your Focus level first: Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus (purple eye icon) shows 4 levels.
Level Focus up with shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
Top the bar up before an attempt: food, drinks and a shower all buff Focus.
Take Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) for a stronger Focus window.
Equip the Duke 556 assault rifle and body armor for the attempt.
Pick the right targets: gang operation criminals — Focus takedowns do NOT count on soldiers, police or civilians.
Start a gang operation and let at least 5 criminals group up in the open.
Aim, then trigger Combat Focus with L3 + R3.
Take down 5 enemies before the Focus bar empties.
If you fall short, rebuild the bar and retry at the next operation — they respawn.
Max Focus to level 4 before serious attempts — it gives the longest window.
Headshots during normal play also feed Focus levels, so aim high on the way.
Land the fifth takedown in one Focus use and the trophy pops.

disputes.a: GTABase decodes it: perform 500 Criminal Profile actions.
disputes.b: GameMapa prints the same decode, with the settings path to enable the tracker.
disputes.call: 500 actions, tracker on, avoid Irredeemable. It completes itself.
disputes.q: What does the riddle description mean?

trophies.guide: The riddle decodes to the Criminal Profile: 500 profile actions across your run. Turn the tracker on in Settings so you can watch them land — and steer clear of the permanent Irredeemable profile.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Enable the tracker: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile.
Watch the demon-face icon — profile actions now show as you perform them.
Know the scale: profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable.
Perform profile actions — your everyday crimes and choices all feed the counter.
The trophy needs 500 profile actions in total.
It comes naturally over a full playthrough; no farming route is needed.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent once reached.
Check the demon-face notifications to confirm actions are registering.
Keep playing your normal run — robberies, escapes and story choices all count.
Turn the tracker on in Chapter 1 so your own count starts with the run.
If you are short late in the run, ordinary free-roam crime continues to add actions.
Perform your 500th profile action and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase agree: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
disputes.b: GTA Zone's roundup lists the stranger finales without separating counters from non-counters.
disputes.call: Four names count. The others are for their own trophies.
disputes.q: Which strangers actually count?

disputes.a: GTABase frames it as 8 mission strands completed across the state.
disputes.b: KeenGamer's roadmap schedules the counting strands inside its stranger step without a per-giver breakdown.
disputes.call: Finish every quest in the four counting strands and the 8 strands complete themselves.
disputes.q: How do the strands add up to 8?

trophies.guide: Only four strangers feed this counter — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — no matter how many other finales you finish. Work their strands quest by quest; the five finale trophies elsewhere in this guide are separate business.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Know which strands count — only four givers feed this counter: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Start Kirk's strand in Vice City; his Skunk Ape line begins with Skunk Apeology 101.
Continue Kirk's strand through Tree Effigies.
Finish Kirk's strand with Mr. Mangrove.
Start Kyle's strand at McKittrick Farm.
Continue Kyle's strand through Chemicals.
Finish Kyle's strand with Buddy?.
Start Yago's street-race strand when he appears.
Complete all 4 of Yago's quests.
Start Pilot Pete's strand with Last Mile.
Complete Pilot Pete's second Last Mile job.
Run Pete's delivery jobs as they appear.
Keep completing strands until the counter reaches 8 mission strands.
Strands unlock at different story points — if a giver has no new quest, progress the story and return.
None of the four counting strands is missable; all stay open after the story.
Do not confuse finale trophies with strands: Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Kenton give trophies, not strands.
Complete the eighth strand and the trophy pops.

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

disputes.a: PowerPyx gives the full method: bridged jets only, E3/E4 easiest, pop after about 1 km.
disputes.b: GameMapa and EGamers still list the trophy as unconfirmed.
disputes.call: One complete method beats two shrugs — steal the bridged jet.
disputes.q: Is the VCIA method confirmed?

trophies.guide: Steal a jet from its boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport and take off. Only bridged jets count, terminals E3/E4 are the softest entry, and the pop lags about a kilometre behind the takeoff.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Travel to Vice City International Airport (VCIA).
Only jets parked at boarding bridges count — planes on the open airfield do not.
Head to terminal E3 or E4, the easiest bridges to reach.
Get airside: climb the fence, or enter through the stairs door beside the boarding bridge.
Alternatively, enter the terminal and make your way up to the bridge level.
Go upstairs into the jet's cockpit.
Reverse the jet out from the boarding bridge.
Take off in the jet.
Fly about 1 km away — the trophy pops with a delay.
A wanted level is likely once you take the jet — the pop lands mid-escape, and that is fine.

disputes.a: PowerPyx locates the Rhinos at Mile Zero Air Station and says to shoot enemies from one.
disputes.b: GameMapa and EGamers still carry it as unconfirmed.
disputes.call: The location is precise and testable. Go to Mile Zero.
disputes.q: Is the tank method confirmed?

trophies.guide: Rhino tanks sit at the south end of Mile Zero Air Station. Get into one and shoot the base's defenders from inside it — the trophy is about using the tank, not stealing it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The Rhino tanks sit at the south end of the base.
Bring armor and snacks — expect heavy resistance at the gate.
Enter the base through the main gate, or stunt-jump in at the south-east entrance.
Fight or sneak your way to a Rhino tank.
Get in the tank.
Use the tank to shoot the base's enemies.
Keep firing from inside the Rhino until the trophy pops.
The trophy pops while you are fighting from the tank.
If the first Rhino is wrecked before you reach it, take the next one in the row.

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

disputes.a: PowerPyx names the place and the drink: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, an Apple Martini, drunk standing at the bar.
disputes.b: GameMapa, EGamers, GTABase and KeenGamer all still list it unconfirmed.
disputes.call: One specific method, four open questions. The martini is cheap — try it first.
disputes.q: Is the cocktail method confirmed?

trophies.guide: One guide has the whole recipe: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, an Apple Martini, drunk standing at the bar facing the view. Every other list still calls it unconfirmed — it costs one drink to test.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Travel to Ocean Beach.
Find the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
Go up to the rooftop bar.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
The description's 'with a view' is literal — face the ocean while you drink.
Drink the martini while standing next to the bar.
If it doesn't pop, reposition right against the bar and drink another Apple Martini.
The trophy pops once the cocktail is enjoyed at the bar.
Visit in daylight for the view — the bar overlooks Ocean Beach.

disputes.a: PowerPyx decodes it as the UFO easter egg north-west of the Starlet Motel, after 2AM.
disputes.b: GamesFuze prints a different wording of the description ('What just happened?') and no method.
disputes.call: The platform wording is 'What the hell just happened?' — and the UFO decode fits it.
disputes.q: What does the description refer to?

trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg with a strict little ritual: night, after 2AM, solo, on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel. Follow the blinking car into the woods, approach what it leads you to, and walk the woman it drops back to her car.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Wait for night, after 2AM, and play solo.
Travel to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Watch for a randomly spawning car with blinking lights.
If no car appears, drive away and return until it spawns.
Follow the blinking car as it leaves the road and takes a path into the woods.
Follow it on foot or by car into the woods.
Approach the UFO at the end of the path.
The UFO drops an abducted woman.
Talk to the woman.
Walk her back to her car — the trophy pops as the encounter resolves.
The encounter is missable per attempt, not per save — the car can spawn again on later nights.

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

disputes.a: PowerPyx: kicking pedestrians from a bike — 10 kicks with Square inside 60 seconds.
disputes.b: KeenGamer words it as a melee drive-by elimination, without the kick detail.
disputes.call: Same act, two wordings. Kick ten people from the bike inside a minute.
disputes.q: What is a 'melee drive-by'?

trophies.guide: A melee drive-by is a kick from a moving bike. Ocean Beach crowds are the densest targets: ride the promenade and land 10 kicks inside 60 seconds.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: Get on any motorcycle.
Ride to Ocean Beach, where pedestrian crowds are densest.
Ride alongside pedestrians and press Square to kick them as you pass.
Each kick is a melee drive-by hit.
Kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds.
Keep your speed up and stay in the crowds — ride the promenade line.
If the count resets, re-run the same stretch — the crowds respawn quickly.
Land the tenth kick inside the minute and the trophy pops.
A wanted level may build during the run — finish the 10 kicks first and escape after.

disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTABase: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10.
disputes.b: Press Start estimates 100+ hours with a 50-hour story; Push Square warns up to 300 hours.
disputes.call: Budget 200 hours. The story is only the first quarter of the work.
disputes.q: How long until the Platinum?

trophies.guide: The Platinum is the other 54 trophies, nothing more and nothing less. Protect the one missable early, rotate your saves, and let the roadmap carry you: story, strands, secrets, then the long 100% grind.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: There is no shortcut: this Platinum is awarded for earning every other trophy.
Follow the roadmap order — story first, then strands, then the 100% grind.
Protect the run's one missable: Positive Mental Attitude's Chapter 1 balcony meditation.
Keep 15 manual saves rotating at chapter starts and ends.
Never enable cheats on your main save — they disable trophies and saving.
Clear the story trophies through Chapter 5 and the finale.
Finish all five stranger finales and the four counting Strangers & Freaks strands.
Complete the 100% checklist for A Long Road.
Sweep the five unconfirmed secret trophies with the methods in this guide.
Track progress in this ledger trophy by trophy; the Platinum needs all 54, with no partial credit.
The Stage 6 order is sequenced so counters overlap — following it saves hours.
Earn the 54th other trophy and the Platinum pops.
